## [1.9.0](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/compare/v1.8.2...v1.9.0) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **baconreader:** pause an ended comment video before its full screen starts it over ([b94e066](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/b94e066ac0050b8c555196275141d9467f76f392))
* **baconreader:** scroll a comment video whole into view when it grows ([96f237f](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/96f237f45e834fc30ecb35f20b0698457b681c51))
* **baconreader:** show a comment video's full screen without Android's prompt, and turn the screen back after it ([ba85673](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/ba856730c9043e91b9320d4c329591090de33d42))
* **baconreader:** show every error in the error dialog, labelled by its source, with a link to the issues ([91e2431](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/91e2431eda4cd658be8f02dfc24649d1e4967bd6)), closes [#142](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/issues/142)

### ✨ New Features

* **baconreader:** add Open web pages in the browser, which opens links to web pages in the user's browser ([dc5a4a5](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/dc5a4a5ad5d7c809de8d5558168bf8130864960b))
* **baconreader:** add Swipe through albums, which goes to the next or previous image of a gallery or album with a swipe ([38719e1](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/38719e1e72fb6914605ef1a999c1169ba7b99aaf))
* **baconreader:** play comment videos at full width, with shrink and full screen buttons ([665ebad](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/665ebade1173e394b7740b81ab77eda48907768a))
